readme.run: Preprocess with FID-A and fit with LCModel
notes: Give the raw files (twix, RDA, DICOM, P-file, SDAT/SPAR, NIfTI-MRS, Bruker)
or folders of them, or an LCModel .RAW; the last argument is a new
output directory. The library's basis sets are included and checked.
No network connection or previously populated cache is required.
Add --help for every setting. Tissue correction from a T1 image needs
the web app; give the voxel's tissue fractions instead.
LCModel is research software. Review each fit before use. Please cite:
Provencher SW. Estimation of metabolite concentrations from localized
in vivo proton NMR spectra. Magn Reson Med 1993;30:672-679.
Simpson R, Devenyi GA, Jezzard P, Hennessy TJ, Near J. Advanced
processing and simulation of MRS data using the FID appliance (FID-A).
